_comment: NOT IN USE. The role this describes (femi9-github-staging-deploy) has never
been successfully assumed: `aws iam get-role --role-name femi9-github-staging-deploy`
reports RoleLastUsed as {}. Both deploy workflows use repository access-key
secrets instead, which is what every successful deploy has used.
What has been ruled out, so the next person does not redo it: the OIDC
provider exists with ClientIDList ['sts.amazonaws.com']; the LIVE trust
policy is broader than this file (sub is `repo:Mohammed-farook-28/femi9:*`);
the repository's owner/name casing matches the sub claim exactly; and the
account is its own AWS Organizations management account, so no SCP applies.
STS returns AccessDenied on a token it does receive.
Worth finishing - short-lived credentials beat stored keys - but it needs a
live console session, not another edit to this file.
